units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:2:4">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᶜ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="C01263"><he>גַּרְגְּרָנוּת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 10:8">Nidd. X, 8</cite> (of one unable to control his sexual appetite).—Pl. <he>גַּרְגְּרָנִין</he>.

<cite ref="Yoma 39a">Yoma 39ᵃ</cite> bot., opp. <he>צנועין</he>.—Fem. <cite ref="C01264"><he>גַּרְגְּרָנִית</he></cite>. Pl. <cite ref="C01264"><he>גַּרְגְּרָנִיּוֹת</he></cite> (unable to resist tasting temptation).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:5">Gen. R. s. 45</cite>; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 6:11">Deut. R. s. 6</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 3:6">Gen. III, 6</cite>).
